decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the core range and still prominently presented on its own page after two years, it appears to justify continued support and still offers upside with limited incremental risk.

The serum has survived on the website since its 2023 launch, but its weaker visibility than Product A suggests more modest traction, so we would keep it while monitoring whether demand strengthens further.

Because this cleansing oil was only launched in 2024 and fits the established portfolio well, uncertainty about its full value is still unresolved and the option value of keeping it likely exceeds its carrying cost for now.
